gitCommit.subject: feat(sdet): POM architecture + pure API contract tests
gitCommit.body:
feat(sdet): POM architecture + pure API contract tests

- Refactor all 4 E2E specs to use Page Object Model (FidelityPage,
  RewardsPage, XianPage, TheAccusedPage) — locators and domain helpers
  encapsulated once, tests focus on assertions only
- Add 5 POM classes under tests/e2e/pages/ with typed interfaces and
  barrel export (index.ts)
- Add 3 pure API contract specs under tests/e2e/api/ (no browser):
  health, fidelity (atomicity invariant), rewards (replay 409)
- Register 'api' Playwright project in playwright.config.ts
- Dashboard: API CONTRACTS card with amber accent + NO BROWSER badge
- README: add Page Object Model and API Contract Tests sections
